> More generally, Bose and Chowla [BoCh62] conjectured that the maximum size of $A\subseteq \{1,\ldots,N\}$ with all $r$-fold sums distinct (aside from the trivial coincidences) then $\lvert A\rvert \sim N^{1/r}.$
